change.after: "Hash algorithm selected based on RSA key length (SHA-384 for 3072-bit, SHA-512 for 4096-bit)"

of.needed: whether RSA certificates with key sizes 3072-bit or 4096-bit are being issued

consequence.statement: RSA certificates with 3072-bit and 4096-bit keys will use SHA-384 and SHA-512 respectively for signature hashing instead of SHA-256, which may affect compatibility with systems that do not support these stronger hash algorithms, though the evidence indicates minimal impact on standard Kubernetes environments.
consequence.remediation: Verify that systems consuming these certificates support SHA-384 and SHA-512 hashing algorithms if you are using RSA keys larger than 2048-bit.

assertion.statement: In cert-manager v1.17.0, RSA certificate signing selects the hash algorithm based on key length: SHA-384 for 3072-bit keys and SHA-512 for 4096-bit keys, replacing the previous behavior of always using SHA-256.
